selection_rule: All canonical nodes touching any tile in the global COLUMN/ROW bounding rectangle of the frozen workload endpoint sites, enlarged by two grid columns/rows. All tile and node types retained; full outgoing rows, all aliases and attributes retained.
source_budget_policy: Stop and record overflow; never clip the selected domain.
training_overlap_policy: Stop before encoding if selected source IDs overlap frozen training sources. Do not remove resources or relabel seen rows as unseen.
scope: Independent regional resource selection from fixed workload endpoint positions, not an untouched statistical holdout or a full-device closed graph. Unknown exterior rows stay explicit.
